description: Searches primary-source documents (laws, budgets, contracts, reports) by title, summary or reference. Open a match with get_document. Matching is the content store's substring match and accents count; search_site folds accents and searches every kind at once. Paginates: when more results remain, the structured answer has a nextCursor (absent on the last page). To continue, call this tool again with the same arguments and cursor set to that value.

cursor.description: Continue a previous result: the nextCursor it returned, unchanged. Only valid with the same other arguments (limit may differ).

name: search_documents

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page: pass it back as the cursor argument, with the same other arguments. Absent on the last page.

total.description: All matching documents, not just this page.

title: Search the source library
